qa_pairs.question: Does an unresolved financial hold prevent a student from completing academic requirements or participating in commencement?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An unresolved financial hold does not erase completed academic requirements, but it blocks new registration, official degree conferral, graduation clearance, and release of final transcripts. The corpus documents do not contain explicit evidence stating whether a financial hold prevents participation in the ceremonial commencement ceremony, so students must verify commencement eligibility directly with the Registrar or Student Accounts.

contexts.text: A financial hold does not erase completed academic requirements, but it blocks official conferral and release of the final transcript until resolved under `03_tuition_payment_refund.md`.
